item.description: There was a time when Test matches were rugby league's biggest, best and bloodiest spectacles, and last night's World Cup opener between Australia and New Zealand was a reminder of those days. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nick Campton

item.title: Six lessons to improve leadership opportunities for women with disability
item.description: Employers must do more to remove the barriers preventing women with disability from progressing into leadership, according to a new report from People with Disability Australia (PWDA), the national disability rights and advocacy organization. Researchers identify six lessons to help drive change. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Infantino apologises for World Cup furore but leaves critics unhappy
item.description: International football officials are seeking more information about two of the biggest controversies that have surrounded FIFA president Gianni Infantino this year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: State government corporation axes Brisbane sign’s Indigenous makeover
item.description: The quiet axing of the proposed temporary artwork has amplified perceptions that Indigenous voices in state activities are being erased. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liam Walsh

item.title: Weekend storms and showers forecast for parts of Queensland
item.description: The storms and strong winds that have hit central Queensland are likely to continue in the coming days, with the state's south-east set for isolated showers well into next week. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jay Carstens

item.title: Council opposes $209m Hindu temple in outer Melbourne green zone
item.description: A 64-metre tall temple planned for Cranbourne South could become the largest of its kind in Australia, but the proposal has triggered concerns it could overwhelm local infrastructure and threaten wildlife. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Margaret Paul

item.title: Amazon sold light months after being told of fire danger
item.description: Amazon Australia was warned months ago that a ceiling light for sale had caught fire and melted during a lab test. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amy Greenbank

item.title: Melbourne man's detention in Vietnam labelled 'outrageous and unacceptable'
item.description: Human rights groups urge the federal government to ratchet up pressure on Vietnam over the fate of an Australian pro-democracy campaigner who is in jail after disappearing in Cambodia last month. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Dziedzic

item.title: Wallaroos believe 'possibilities are endless' ahead of 2029 World Cup
item.description: Their results may not show improvement, but the Wallaroos are making progress three years out from the Women's Rugby Cup, which Australia will host. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Luke Pentony

item.title: Councillor told woman it was a 'pity' she wasn't bashed, investigator finds
item.description: A Kempsey Shire councillor maintains his social media account was hacked after an investigator finds he told a woman it was a "pity" she had not been assaulted by an alleged domestic violence offender. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Marina Trajkovich

item.title: De Minaur falls to world number one Zverev in Shanghai
item.description: Top-ranked Alexander Zverev said he felt good on court after beating Alex de Minaur 6-4, 6-4 at the Shanghai Masters. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Dead man found north of Melbourne may have been targeted
item.description: The man was found at a property in Wollert and his death is being investigated by Homicide detectives. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Friday news quiz: Investigate a fake murder and meet some introverted seabirds
item.description: Don't believe any tips that hit your inbox promising the lowdown on how to ace this week's news quiz. You can't trust them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lincoln Archer

item.title: Builder revealed, but cost of new stadium still 'being worked through'
item.description: With an updated price tag for Hobart's AFL stadium expected to be released by the end of the year, the Tasmanian premier has skirted around questions on whether he would limit Tasmania's contribution to $875 million. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jano Gibson

item.title: How the joy of Pride is 'a form of resistance' against queer discrimination
item.description: GWS player Tilly Lucas-Rodd said the conversations around AFLW Pride Round are important to keep platforming, as the joy is a counter to the discrimination queer people still face in sport. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Marnie Vinall

item.title: Dispute over outbreak that was 'like seasick, times 10' on Spirit ferry
item.description: A severe gastro outbreak on the Spirit of Tasmania V during its delivery voyage earlier this year has become the focus of a pay dispute in the Fair Work Commission. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jano Gibson

item.title: Journalist Amy Goodman won't take 'no comment' for an answer
item.description: Oscar-nominated filmmakers Tia Lessin and Carl Deal documented years in the life of an indomitable newshound. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen A Russell

item.title: An Australian band’s ‘unreal’ journey to break a gig world record
item.description: The dream rock band called Fathom travelled roughly 700km across Australia by car, helicopter and plane to play nine shows in 12 hours. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Victorian schools told to remind parents education is free
item.description: The principals' association says Victorian schools will be made financially worse off by an education department directive to stress that contributions are voluntary in the public system. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sacha Payne

item.title: Alleged Chinese spy posed as recruiter for 'retired Australian police'
item.description: A suspected Chinese spying network contacted Australians on LinkedIn using a fake security firm in an effort to encourage them to share information, an ABC investigation has found. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Echo Hui and Meghna Bali
